thread:
zoe: hi! day 2 here, hitting a blocker: trying to pull a CI secret at secret/data/ci/infra/token and getting 403. who do I ping to get access?
tyler: welcome Zoe. quick Qs: did you file the onboarding secrets form? are you logged into Vault with OIDC? which team?
zoe: submitted the form a few mins ago (2026-ONB-912). did browser OIDC login earlier. team=infra-ci.
tyler: infra-ci secrets require owner's approval + infra-security signoff. @june_security can expedite?
june_security: we can. for CI read we need: ticket with repo + pipeline id + approvers listed. SLA is ~1 business day; we can fast-track if approvers reply. Also note: prefer workload identity over stored SA keys.
sre-bot: Request 2026-ONB-912 received. Estimated completion: 1 business day. Add approvers to ticket to speed up.
zoe: thanks. if they grant access, how do I verify from my laptop?
tyler: do `vault login -method=oidc` then `vault kv get secret/data/ci/infra/token`. if you see JSON creds you're good. `vault token lookup` shows attached policies.
june_security: and remember rotation: CI secrets under `secret/data/ci/` rotate monthly by automation. If you need ephemeral creds, add `secrets-mint` to the ticket.
zoe: perfect, thanks everyone :smile:
